judgement_calls_requiring_explicit_HQ_ra.call: candidate_class_ref is a MANDATORY positively bounded key component, and an unbounded class is a terminal refusal.
judgement_calls_requiring_explicit_HQ_ra.basis: Derived by binding D15's prohibition 'May not silently backfill broader sources.' into a structural requirement. Without a bounded class the 'admissible set' degenerates to 'all sources', which is not an admission decision.
judgement_calls_requiring_explicit_HQ_ra.risk_if_HQ_rejects: If HQ judges this too strong, the form must still forbid silent broadening by some other means; the prohibition itself is D15's, not mine.

judgement_calls_requiring_explicit_HQ_ra.call: A NEW state family SERVICE_SOURCE_APPLICABILITY_STATE is mandatory; applicability states may not alias SOURCE_UNIVERSE_RELATION_STATE, P07_RELATION_DECISIONS, EMPIRICAL_FACT_STATE or AUTHORITY_STATE.
judgement_calls_requiring_explicit_HQ_ra.basis: NOT_APPLICABLE, NONCOMPARABLE and OUT_OF_SCOPE each already appear in more than one existing STATE_FAMILY at b65673abc. Aliasing would make an applicability refusal indistinguishable from a relation refusal and would destroy D15's separation of the two authorities in the type system.
judgement_calls_requiring_explicit_HQ_ra.precedent: pre553_structural_admission.py already keeps an exact internal decision vocabulary and coarsens it explicitly via PUBLIC_STATE_BY_DECISION, with the comment 'I01 freezes a deliberately coarser public state vocabulary while preserving the exact P06 state in admission_decision_state. I04 must not widen I01.'

judgement_calls_requiring_explicit_HQ_ra.call: The proposed public positive state is named APPLICABLE, not ADMITTED_FOR_APPLICABILITY_PURPOSES.
judgement_calls_requiring_explicit_HQ_ra.basis: To prevent collision with ADMITTED_FOR_EXACT_STRUCTURAL_USE in STRUCTURAL_ADMISSION_STATE. Two grains, two names; one word never means both.

judgement_calls_requiring_explicit_HQ_ra.call: UNDETERMINED candidates are surfaced with candidate_class_coverage = INCOMPLETE and do NOT force a whole-request refusal.
judgement_calls_requiring_explicit_HQ_ra.basis: The less powerful of the two coherent options. The stronger option - refuse the entire request if any candidate is undecided - is defensible but withholds genuine partial determinations. Surfacing preserves both the truth and the fail-closed property, provided INCOMPLETE is mandatory and cannot be omitted.
judgement_calls_requiring_explicit_HQ_ra.alternative_HQ_may_prefer: Full-request refusal whenever candidate_class_coverage would be INCOMPLETE. This would be strictly safer and is one line of policy.

judgement_calls_requiring_explicit_HQ_ra.call: MISS-04 is restated: no SELECTION-REASON record is required, because no selection occurs. ADMISSION PROVENANCE is the lawful substitute and is strictly weaker.
judgement_calls_requiring_explicit_HQ_ra.basis: H-C recorded MISS-04 as an unmet instance-level consequence. On derivation, requiring a selection reason would either fabricate a selection or misrepresent an independent per-source determination as a comparative judgement. Recording why a source was ADMITTED is required; recording why it was CHOSEN is not, because choosing is not authorised.

judgement_calls_requiring_explicit_HQ_ra.call: The candidate-class bound is a required key component even though the commission's enumeration of the service-request key did not name it.
judgement_calls_requiring_explicit_HQ_ra.basis: The commission asked for 'all relevant governed scope'. An unbounded candidate class is the exact mechanism by which D15's no-broader-backfill prohibition would be violated, so it is relevant governed scope and is included.
